title: Simulation of Axion-Induced Electromagnetic Signal Detection Using Plasmonic Metasurfaces and Diamond NV Centers
summary: The axion represents a strong candidate for weakly interacting dark matter. To date, high sensitivity lab based experiments and astrophysical observations have ruled out a substantial part of the axion mass and photon coupling parameter space. However, a challenge remains in searching for the presence of the axion in the higher mass range 0.01-1eV corresponding approximately to axion field oscillation at THz frequencies.
